tasks.title: Bitwise Parity & Power Verification
tasks.story: Corrupted binary telemetry is flooding Earth Prime power relays. You must write a routine to verify if incoming energy packets are exact powers of two using fast bitwise operations.
tasks.prompt: Given an array of integers {4, 7, 16, 25, 64, 100}, print each number followed by 'POWER_OF_2' if it is a power of 2, or 'ODD_PACKET' otherwise. Each result on its own line.
tasks.expectedOutput:
4 POWER_OF_2
7 ODD_PACKET
16 POWER_OF_2
25 ODD_PACKET
64 POWER_OF_2
100 ODD_PACKET
hints: In binary, powers of 2 have only 1 bit set (e.g., 16 is 00010000).
n - 1 flips all bits up to the lowest set bit. So (n & (n - 1)) evaluates to 0 for powers of 2!

tasks.title: Stack Frame Recursion Echo
tasks.story: The Function Nexus call-stack gateway has an echo loop. Transmit a recursive string inverter function to collapse stack overflow anomalies.
tasks.prompt: Implement a recursive function 'void reverseEcho(const std::string& str, int index)' that prints the characters of the string 'NEXUS' in reverse order followed by a newline.
hints: Start index at str.length() - 1.
Print str[index] directly without spaces.
Decrement index until it drops below 0.

tasks.title: Shield Generator Encapsulation
tasks.story: Build an encapsulated ShieldGenerator class with private integrity fields and public calibration methods to withstand malware intrusions.
tasks.prompt: Create class ShieldGenerator with private int shieldHP = 100. Add public methods: void absorb(int dmg) and void boost(int heal) and int getIntegrity() const. Print initial integrity, integrity after 35 damage, and integrity after 15 boost.
hints: Encapsulation prevents outside access to shieldHP directly.
Implement absorb() to subtract damage and boost() to add energy.

tasks.title: Polymorphic Drone Swarm Interface
tasks.story: Polymorphism City defensive turrets must fire via abstract base pointer interface so new drone variants can be deployed dynamically.
tasks.prompt: Implement base class Drone with virtual void ping(). Derive ReconDrone and override ping() to print 'Recon Drone Scanning Area\n'. In main, dispatch via Drone* pointer to display polymorphic dispatch.
tasks.expectedOutput:
Drone Online
Recon Drone Scanning Area
hints: Mark the overridden method with override keyword in ReconDrone.
The virtual table resolves the derived call at runtime through the pointer.

tasks.title: Raw Pointer Memory Array Scan
tasks.story: A memory leak has fragmented sector 0x7FFE. Walk an integer array using pure pointer arithmetic without bracket indexing ([]) to sum safe sector addresses.
tasks.prompt: Given array int sectors[] = {12, 24, 36, 48, 60}; calculate the sum of all elements using a pointer int* ptr = sectors and pointer increments ptr++. Print 'SUM: <sum>\n'.
hints: Dereference with *ptr to retrieve the integer value.
Advance the address with ptr++.

tasks.title: STL Vector Transformation
tasks.story: The STL Galaxy hyperspace beacons are out of sync. Double each number in energy coordinate vector and print them separated by spaces.
tasks.prompt: Given std::vector<int> vals = {3, 8, 12, 17, 20}; print each number multiplied by 2 separated by single spaces, ending with a newline.
hints: Multiply each element by 2.
Print with space delimiters: 6 16 24 34 40.

tasks.title: STL Map Key Frequency Counter
tasks.story: Decode frequency of intercepted corrupted signal transmissions using std::map key-value mapping.
tasks.prompt: Given vector of signal tags {'ALPHA', 'BETA', 'ALPHA', 'GAMMA', 'BETA', 'ALPHA'}, insert them into std::map<std::string, int> freq. Print each key and count in format '<KEY>: <COUNT>\n' in alphabetical order.
hints: std::map automatically sorts keys alphabetically.
Use freq[s]++ to increment each occurrence.

tasks.title: Const-Correct Compiler Optimization
tasks.story: Core Compiler -O3 optimization requires strictly const-correct references to prevent unnecessary memory copy overhead during high-speed parsing.
tasks.prompt: Implement function void printReport(const std::string& label, const int& code) that outputs 'STATUS: [' << label << '] CODE: ' << code << '\n'. Call with label 'CORE_STABLE' and code 200.
hints: Pass strings as const std::string& to eliminate heap copies.
Format output strictly to match STATUS: [CORE_STABLE] CODE: 200.

tasks.title: Standard Stream Summation Protocol
tasks.story: The network data stream injects packets through standard input. Read the count N and sum each packet value.
tasks.prompt: Read integer N from std::cin, then read N numbers from std::cin and calculate their sum. Output 'SUM: ' followed by the total sum.
hints: Use std::cin >> n to read the total number of items.
Use a loop reading each next number into a variable with std::cin >> val.
Print output as: std::cout << "SUM: " << sum << "\n";

tasks.title: Stream Token Frequency Counter
tasks.story: Scan an incoming data stream of string tokens and tally all occurrences of the target identifier 'cpp'.
tasks.prompt: Read words from standard input until end-of-stream (cin >> word) and output 'COUNT(cpp): ' followed by the number of times 'cpp' appeared.
tasks.sampleInput: cpp codeverse cpp nexus guardian cpp
hints: Use while (std::cin >> word) to parse whitespace-separated tokens until EOF.
Check if (word == "cpp") and increment your counter.
Print output strictly matching: COUNT(cpp): <count>
